List<SequenceRange> function ( ) {
  
  List<SequenceRange> sequences = new ArrayList<>();

  // get the current profiles segment start and end
  long segmentStart = getSegmentChrStart();
  long segmentEnd = getSegmentChrEnd();

  // compute the ranges for each query sequence
  for (QuerySequence sequence : getQuerySequences()) {
    long sequenceStart = sequence.getChrStart();
    long sequenceEnd = sequence.getChrEnd();

    // skip sequences that are outside of the current profiles segment
    if (segmentStart > sequenceEnd || segmentEnd < sequenceStart) {
      continue;
    }

    // compute the intersection between the sequence and the current profiles segment
    long intersectionStart = Math.max(segmentStart, sequenceStart);
    long intersectionEnd = Math.min(segmentEnd, sequenceEnd);

    // add the intersection to the list of valid sequences
    sequences.add(new SequenceRange(sequence.getName(), intersectionStart, intersectionEnd, sequence.getDirection()));
  }

  return sequences;
